inbox.paymentGone: A payment that you can no longer see

triggers.payment_due: A payment reaches its due day

reasons.daftra_not_ready: Daftra is not set up for this office yet.
reasons.daftra_bad_key: Madar cannot sign in to Daftra. Ask an Admin.
reasons.daftra_refused: Daftra does not let Madar read this. Ask an Admin.
reasons.daftra_unreachable: Madar could not reach Daftra. Try again in a minute.
reasons.daftra_no_client: Add a client to this project to link a Daftra invoice.
reasons.daftra_no_match: Find the client in Daftra first.
reasons.daftra_client_mismatch: This invoice is for another Daftra client.
reasons.daftra_draft: This invoice is a draft in Daftra.
reasons.daftra_invoice_taken: Another payment has this Daftra invoice.
reasons.daftra_invoice_changed: This invoice changed. Choose it again.
reasons.daftra_already_linked: This payment has another Daftra invoice. Unlink it first.
reasons.daftra_final: Daftra set this payment as received. Unlink the invoice, then change the payment.
